blocks.text: CITY OF MALOLOS — Bulacan has launched its own pickleball league called the All-Star Champions Pickleball League and has started its first tournament over the weekend at the Capitol Gymnasium in Malolos City. More than 80 pickleball clubs and teams in the province participated in the tournament, said Vice Gov. Alexis Castro, who spearheaded the tournament. It is the first time a major pickleball competition has been held in the province, as the paddle sport has become a craze in almost all of Bulacan’s 20 towns and four cities.
